import JudgeProblem

def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  have h19 : ∀ a b c : G, a = b ◇ (c ◇ a) := by
    intro a b c
    let v0 : G := ((a ◇ (a ◇ a)) ◇ a)
    exact (h a b).trans (congrArg (fun t => b ◇ t) ((h v0 c).trans (congrArg (fun t => c ◇ t) ((h a (v0 ◇ (v0 ◇ v0))).symm))))
  intro x y
  exact h19 x x ((y ◇ y) ◇ y)
